text: Why choose to study this program? MASTA (Master Program on Space Technology Applications) has been an elaborately designed and an intensive Master Program on space technology applications in Beihang University since 2006, sponsored by the Secretariat of Asia-Pacific Multilateral Cooperation in Space Technology and Applications (AP-MCSTA). It focuses on both knowledge acquisition and operational training, and is an engineering and application-oriented program with flexible curricula. It provides a powerful platform for scholars and professionals to obtain more opportunities for communicating and experiencing the space technology practice in China. English will be used as teaching and instruction language. Note: Only when the number of the qualified applicants for one major is over 15 the class will be opened. Main Courses and Credits Major Courses: Introduction to Satellite Communication, Electromagnetic Wave and Antennas, Principles of Satellite Communications, The Opening of Experiments of SATCOM, Satellite Communication Networks, Rules, Regulations and Procedures of ITU, Case Studies in the Applications of Satellite Communications, Software Applications of STK etc. See more detailed course information please download the MASTA-SATCOM Curriculum Catalogue. Program Schedule MASTA will launch a two-stage program: Stage Ⅰ: 9-12 months in BUAA for the Core Course; Stage Ⅱ: 6-12 months in BUAA or home country for Advanced Research Projects.
